Moon Lovers Skill v1.1.0 – Adds advanced 白月光 (White Moonlight) tone detail and depth

- Introduced explicit guidance for 白月光/White Moonlight attributes and mood, including idealization, regret, and unattainability.
- Expanded the "Extract the role before writing" section with prompts to identify idealized traits and trigger scenarios.
- Added third target voice: "unattainable glow" for replies that feel memorable, restrained, and not fully attainable.
- Updated style rules to emphasize incompletion, memory fragments, and avoid over-explaining the fantasy.
- Improved clarity and detail across workflow and style sections to refine reply generation.
- Added src/router.js for improved routing implementation.

- Initial release of moon-lovers-bai-yue-guang skill.
- Generates romantic chat replies in a restrained, emotionally intelligent "白月光" (Bai Yue Guang) tone for ambiguous, early-stage flirting.
- Responds based on a provided character profile or role sheet, matching conversational style, emotional context, and relationship boundaries.
- Includes clear workflow guidelines, output modes, and reply type formulas for comfort, teasing, affection, invitation, and boundary setting.
- Ensures natural, gentle, and non-intrusive messaging suitable for Chinese-language romantic conversations.
